summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end verification of all four fixes passed 6/6 UI+API. (1) Refund two-phase: 'Reembolsar' click on stock-review order transitioned payment_status=approved -> refund_requested (NOT refunded) with refund.status=requested; refund-pending-{order_id} panel + refund-confirm-{order_id} button rendered as specified; second call to /admin/orders/{id}/resolve-stock returned 200 with idempotent note ('Reembolso já está em andamento (requested) — nenhuma nova operação criada.') and did NOT duplicate the refund record; 'Confirmar estorno' click finalized to payment_status=refunded, refund.status=confirmed, refund.confirmed_at set, and 'Reembolsado em ...' confirmation line rendered. (2) Sales suspension: settings-sales-status=Suspensas + Salvar propagated to /api/settings; on /carrinho the sales-suspended-banner is visible with the correct copy and cart-checkout-btn is disabled; POST /api/checkout returns 403 with the suspension message; reverting to open restores normal flow. (3) Unconfirmed zones: after unconfirming zone_sp_capital via admin/shipping upsert, cart quote for CEP 01310100 renders shipping-error 'Ainda não entregamos nesta região...'; clicking zone-confirm-zone_sp_capital in admin Frete tab sets confirmed=true and cart then quotes R$ 3.919,90 with shipping-deadline '1 a 3 dias úteis'. (4) Backups: backup-list visible in Frete tab with at least one entry, backup-verify-{id} button click produces success indication mentioning 'Restauração' (verify-restore endpoint responded). Regression: register→checkout→confirm-demo→GET /orders end-to-end works (order appears in customer's list). Mobile 390x844 shows no horizontal overflow on /, /catalogo, /carrinho. Final DB state left clean: sales_status=open, zone_sp_capital.confirmed=true; test users/sessions cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1508 lines — still no split; strongly recommend modularizing (auth, catalog, orders/checkout, admin, shipping, backups, cron) before adding more features.

resolve-stock 'refund' branch is correctly idempotent (guards on refund.status in requested/processing/confirmed) and only transitions payment_status to refund_requested on the first call; /admin/orders/{id}/refund/confirm is the ONLY code path that flips to refunded and dispatches the send_order_cancelled email — great two-phase design.
Customer notification (send_order_cancelled) is correctly dispatched only from refund/confirm, satisfying the 'email only after Confirmar estorno' requirement.
/checkout sales_status guard placed BEFORE mutation (line 830), so it does not affect webhooks or already-created orders — correct.
Public /shipping/zones filters by confirmed:true (line 766, 775) — unconfirmed seed zones cannot be used until owner confirms, as specified.
AdminPage.jsx is now ~553 lines mixing 8 tabs — consider splitting per-tab components under /pages/admin/.

The admin/shipping POST upsert accepts arbitrary boolean 'confirmed' from the payload, which means a staff member could theoretically POST the zone with confirmed:true to bypass the owner-only confirmation. Consider forcing confirmed=false on new-zone upserts and requiring an owner-only PATCH for the confirmed flag (defense-in-depth).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter4 features are green. Playwright notes for iter5: (a) admin session injection works via cookie 'session_token' on the preview domain (httpOnly:false in playwright works fine because backend accepts the cookie regardless of the HttpOnly attribute); Bearer with the raw session token does NOT work — always use fetch({credentials:'include'}) after add_cookies. (b) resolveStock uses window.prompt() so register page.on('dialog', d=>d.accept('reason')) before clicking. (c) Cart is client-side (localStorage 'minha_adega_cart_v1'); seed it directly to test cart-page states without going through a product page. (d) Admin tab testids: admin-tab-{resumo|produtos|pedidos|estoque|frete|cupons|relatorios|equipe|config}. (e) Sales-status select testid is settings-sales-status (not admin-sales-status). (f) To unconfirm a zone via API use POST /api/admin/shipping (upsert) with confirmed:false, not the missing PUT endpoint.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Two-phase refund correctly separates request (payment_status=refund_requested, no customer notification) from confirmation (payment_status=refunded, send_order_cancelled dispatched). Idempotency is enforced by checking refund.status ∈ {requested, processing, confirmed} before creating a new refund record. Sales suspension is enforced only on POST /checkout (line 830) leaving webhooks/admin/refund paths unaffected. Unconfirmed zones are filtered out of the public /shipping/zones and /checkout quote paths, blocking new orders until owner confirmation.
